mapper.insert:
SELECT review_idx.nextval from dual
INSERT INTO studycafe_reply(review_idx, user_idx, studycafe_idx, studycafe_reply, studycafe_rating, created_at) VALUES(#{review_idx}, #{user_idx}, #{studycafe_idx}, #{studycafe_reply}, #{studycafe_rating}, sysdate)

INSERT INTO studycafe_reply_file(review_idx, review_file_idx, file_path, file_type, file_order, created_at) VALUES(#{review_idx}, review_file_idx.nextval, #{file_path}, #{file_type}, #{file_order}, sysdate)
mapper.select: select sr.review_idx, sr.user_idx, sr.studycafe_reply, sr.studycafe_idx, sr.studycafe_rating, sr.created_at, srf.review_file_idx, srf.file_path, srf.file_type, srf.file_order from studycafe_reply sr left join studycafe_reply_file srf on sr.review_idx = srf.review_idx where sr.studycafe_idx = #{studycafe_idx} order by sr.review_idx desc, file_order asc
